summary.keyBehavior: GET /activate with no session and no query params does NOT render any activate/waitlist UI directly — it 302s server-side to /sign-in before the client ever sees /activate content. This matches source: ActivatePage awaits getServerSession() and calls redirect('/sign-in') immediately when session is absent. Full /activate behavior (ActivationForm / WaitlistApplyForm / WaitlistPendingForm) is only reachable post-authentication and depends on ?hasCode= and the caller's waitlist row status — none of that was exercised in this anonymous smoke pass by design.
unexpectedObservations: Email input on the landed /sign-in page was pre-filled with 'not-an-email' and auto-focused on arrival, despite this being a fresh navigation — likely stale browser autofill carried over from a prior test on the same tab/profile rather than an app bug, but flagged for re-verification in a clean context.
